name: 360 ONE WAM LTD
title: 360 ONE WAM LTD - 542772 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wealth and AMC franchise posted record FY26 PAT of Rs 1,225 crores (+20.7%) and organic net flows of Rs 35,199 crores (+36%), but Q4 AMC net flows fell to ~2,300-2,400 crores on maturities and management guided to a 15-25% profit growth range.

triggers.label: Q4 AMC gross flows 5,200 cr, net ~2,400 cr
triggers.quote: the gross flow for the quarter is around 5,200. And for the full year, it is 19,000

triggers.label: Wealth profit growth guided 15-25%
triggers.quote: effectively grow our profits on the Wealth Management side by 15 -25%

triggers.label: Alternates yield ~95-100 bps modelled
triggers.quote: about 95 -100 basis points on Alternates is the yield I would look at

triggers.label: Discretionary PMS outflows, softer growth
triggers.quote: the growth there has been slightly softer than what we would have wanted

guidance.metric: Wealth net flows as % of opening AUM
guidance.quote: we really strongly believe we should be able to get to 12-15% of our opening AUM every year as net flows
we should be able to grow our AUM on the Wealth Management side by 20-25%
effectively grow our profits on the Wealth Management side by 15 -25%
move towards the 45 to 46 to 47% numbers
I would feel much more comfortable over 170-180 crore number as compared to 130-140 crore number in the past

guidance.value: ~10 bps of carryable AUM per year
guidance.quote: from a modelling perspective, I would say approximately 10 basis points is the right number to look at
we would expect the business to head towards breakeven in the near term

prior_guidance_check.quote: 125-130 crores of quarterly TBR now today looks like closer to the 175-180 crores of TBR for sure

red_flags.label: Q4 AMC net flows fell sharply on maturities
red_flags.quote: which has resulted in the 5,300 crores coming down to the 2,300 to 2,400 crore number

red_flags.label: Discretionary PMS outflows and benchmark-hugging underperformance
red_flags.quote: where we've tried to do very, very benchmark hugging portfolios on the discretionary PMS side, that maybe is not really kind of worked out

red_flags.label: Tax demand Rs 336 crore
red_flags.quote: we have received an order today from the tax authorities with an aggregate demand of Rs. 336 crores

evasions.quote: that I'll have to just depend on Sanjay or Anshuman first for the gross flow numbers

evasions.topic: Carry fund list and exit map
evasions.quote: I'll give the operating principles and leave it to Sanjay to figure out how to maybe potentially give a list of funds
